Mobilunity offers two cooperation models for you to hire the top C++ developers and engineers. At the same time, we’re ready to customize the format to meet your business needs.

Dedicated C++ Developers

With full-time remote C++ software engineers, you can embrace all the aspects of C and the solutions you develop. You manage 100% of their workload distribution and performance, and Mobilunity handles the back-office duties. Systems Programming

Networking and Communication Protocols

Our developers can design and implement protocols for data transmission, build networked applications, and optimize communication systems for connectivity across distributed environments.

Testing and Quality Assurance

With automated tools and manual testing used by our QA specialists, you’ll identify bugs, validate your software solution’s functionality, and ensure it meets your user and system requirements.

Our 3R Approach for Your Perfect C++ Developer Match

Mobilunity’s 3R of Nearshoring philosophy (Recruitment, Retention, Relationships) allows us to address clients’ pain points and expectations. It lets us ensure you hire an experienced C++ developer with the required skill set and cultural values. 

1R

Recruitment

Our targeted talent acquisition, proactive communication, and risk mitigation enable our competent tech recruiters to find the right C++ developers within weeks, not months. Additionally, we help you cut costs significantly by charging affordable fees and hiring in offshore locations. 

2R

Retention

We emphasize continuous and effective retention of your remote developers since it’s the cornerstone of your project continuity. Our Resource Managers consistently engage with engineers to keep them productive, address potential dissatisfaction early, and prevent turnover.

3R

Relationships

We build deep, meaningful partnerships, prioritizing human connections over processes to fit our clients’ needs. Regular feedback loops keep us aligned with clients’ expectations, as our success is closely tied to their achievements and our transparent communication.

FAQs

How much does it cost to hire a C++ developer with Mobilunity?

The cost will depend on a developer’s technical skills, their country, the demand for C++ specialists in the local market, and our cooperation format. Schedule a free consultation to get the cost estimate.

What sets Mobilunity apart from traditional outsourcing?

In contrast to delivering turnkey solutions, we contract C++ developers with relevant experience in software development who will help you build the required systems and applications. 

How quickly can I hire C++ developers through Mobilunity?

Our recruiters will need from 3 to 6 weeks on average to find and contract developers as per your needs. However, recruiting may last longer if you’re looking to hire developers based in regions with high-demand markets for tech talent, like Western Europe. 

What industries do your C++ developers for hire specialize in?

We can find software developers with deep knowledge in finance, healthcare, automotive, gaming, telecommunications, or other fields, so we’ll find the right expert for your needs.  

How does Mobilunity ensure high retention rates?

Our retention policy assumes continuous support, professional development, and a positive professional environment for your C++ developers. Such an approach keeps them engaged and motivated, contributing to your project’s stability. 

What is the cost structure for hiring C++ developers through Mobilunity?

We cover the salary, taxes, office infrastructure, and retention fees for both dedicated development teams and part-time C++ developers, keeping the costs fully transparent to our clients.

Can I scale my remote coding team up or down?

Sure, once you need to add C++ developers swiftly or you don’t want to hire that many developers anymore, we’ll adjust the size of your squad to your project requirements. 

How does Mobilunity handle administrative tasks?

Mobilunity covers legal compliance, salary payments, tax reports, HR assistance, and IT support. Once your C++ developer needs additional hardware or software, our team can also arrange the purchase. 

What kind of support does Mobilunity offer during the project?

In addition to back-office coverage, our team provides your remote developers with employee retention programs, 1:1 sessions, crisis management, entertainment services, and more — all of which encourage your C++ developers to meet your project goals.
